fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Kling AI API key (kling.ai/dev console > '+ Create a new API Key'; shown once), sent as Authorization: Bearer. The legacy AccessKey/SecretKey JWT scheme is not needed.

adapter.terms: Generated images/videos are deleted after 30 days; save results promptly. Concurrency is limited per account (Concurrency Rules).

me.note: GET /account/costs?start_time&end_time (ms, the last 30 days): resource packages with remaining quantity; used as the credential check (no user endpoint).

generate_image.note: POST /v1/images/generations {model_name (kling-v3 default, kling-v2-1), prompt, negative_prompt (text-to-image only), image (reference URL/base64), aspect_ratio (16:9 default, 9:16, 1:1 …)} -> data {task_id, task_status}; poll with get_job.

generate_video.note: POST /text-to-video/{model} (default kling-3.0) {prompt, settings: {aspect_ratio 16:9|9:16|1:1, duration 3–15}} -> data {id, status}; poll with get_job. image_url is not sent (image-to-video is a separate endpoint).

get_job.note: GET /tasks?task_ids={id} ('Query Task (By task ID)'): status submitted|processing|succeeded|failed, message on failure, outputs[] with url/watermark_url per image/video/audio (all in raw.outputs). URLs expire after 30 days.

not_offered.list_items: No content-item resource; task listings (POST /tasks by cursor) are generation history, not items.

evidence: host api-singapore.klingai.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (GlobalSign nv-sa)
probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 2/4 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; names not found on the page: get_job:task_ids, generate_video:prompt, generate_video:settings
